title: Eathon Lambert
summary: Eathon Lambert is a legendary Seeker and member of the Huntik Foundation. He is also the father of Kathy and Lok Lambert. Though he has been missing for a decade, he is still alive in the Spirit World of Huntik. His journal was found by Lok and Sophie Casterwill. His signature Titan is Jirwolf, but what happened to it is unknown.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Eathon became a Seeker at a young age, under the watch and guidance of his mentor Simon Judeau. In the mid-late 1950s, the pair became acquainted with Metz, whom they met by chance on a street in Venice, Italy. Forming an inseparable Seeker team, together the trio embarked on many adventures, travelling around the world, including Peru, finding hidden Titans for the Huntik Foundation. Within the group, Metz served as the muscle, Judeau the brains, and Eathon as the intuition. [S1E24]

However, this all changed the day that they tried to find one of the Legendary Titans, Araknos. Upon finding at the Titan's resting place, Metz read the ancient scripts carved on the door of Araknos' Tomb and decided that they should leave the Titan. Simon however threw caution to the winds and forcefully entered the tomb but was cursed by the magic within. Simon was left hospitalised for years, and Eathon loyally stayed at his bedside, day and night, for the whole of 1958. When Simon was well enough to walk again, he suddenly disappeared a word, leaving only his Titan, Dendras, behind so that Eathon could bond with it. [S1E24] A few months later, an extremely disfigured-looking Simon returned and confronted Eathon in the Huntik Foundation Italian HQ, asking him to join him and be his "dog". The altercation was witnessed by Clease and Simon vanished again. [S1E24] 

Eathon became a legendary Seeker within the Foundation and formed the very first Huntik Foundation Council. [S1E24] He later met and married a fellow Foundaation agent, Sandra Lambert. They settled down in Sandra's home of County Kerry, Ireland, and had two children, Kathy and Lok. [Home Turf] On one occasion, Eathon took Sandra on a picnic to see the floating castle of Tír na nÓg at night, with Sandra slapping him as he had promised he had retired from adventuring. [Back Home]

Eathon continued his travels around the world, bringinf back artifacts for his son, Lok, who would imagine all the places where he had found them. [Divide and Conquer] Eathon believed Lok would one day follow in his footsteps as a Seeker, and therefore left several of his Titans for him to find, hiding his Kipperin in an old vase [S1E01], hiding Springer in a puzzle in the Paris Catacombs [S1E05] [Huntik.com] and leaving Baselaird in a box at the Temple of Poseidon. [S1E20] 

Eathon eventually disappeared after taking up a final quest for the Amulet of Will, a journey that took him to many different locations across the world, pursued by the Simon, now known as the Professor, and his personal guard. He left many of his Titans for his son, Lok Lambert, to He eventually found the path to Atlantis and fought an incredible battle there, but never managed to make it to the tests. [S1E21] The chase lasted for some number of years until it ended at the edge of a waterfall in South America, where he came face to face with Simon after so many years. [The Mission] Eathon, not wanting to betray his secrets to the Professor's mind control powers, faked his own death by jumping from the waterfall, leading him to think he was dead. In reality, he managed to enter a secret cavern behind the falls and escaped through a Nexus into the Spirit World, Huntik. [Doorway to Huntik]

Before his disappearance, Eathon kept a journal full of his secrets as a Seeker that became an item that the Professor's Organization were anxious to obtain. When Lok and Sophie found it, hidden inside an old artifact, both the Organization and the Huntik Foundation sought their claim on its secrets. When it was damaged in a confrontation between Organization Suits and Lok, the only remaining clue about his father's whereabouts was the mentioning of an ancient artifact, the Amulet of Will. [A Seeker is Born]

For a long time Lok was uncertain whether or not his father, Eathon, survived as clues both for and against his survival were found in the Foundation's missions to find Eathon. One main clue was found in Atlantis, where its Mermen guards said that no one had passed the city's gates in thousands of years. Due to this, Lok suspected that his father either was unable to pass or never made it to Atlantis. Though later suspected that he was somehow turned into the Professor's dog, named Eathon, the team later uncover that this was simply coincidental.

When the Professor was finally confronted by Lok and Dante Vale's team, he began to tell the tale of his men chasing down Eathon, although the Professor did not include whether or not Eathon managed escaped. This oversight may have simply been to stall Lok. [The Mission]

Some time after the defeat of the Professor, Lok Lambert and the rest of the team discovered that Eathon was still alive in the Spirit World, Huntik, by using Eathon's Holotome and Januseea the Gatekeeper with the Nexus in South America. Eathon warns his son of the Blood Spiral Brotherhood, the enemy of the Casterwill family, and sends his son after the lost quatrains of Nostradamus. [Doorway to Huntik]

Since this encounter, a Holotome projection of Eathon Lambert began to give clues to Lok during many of his missions. Several of these missions end in failure, with the Blood Spiral Brotherhood claiming the Amulet of Void and the Necklace of Tutankhamun.

When Lok found himself in the Spirit World, Huntik, the Holotome would not activate. Instead, Lok sees an image of his father on a mirror within this dimension before being returned to his own plane of existence by Umbra. [Back Home]

The "Eathon" that had been giving these clues was later found out to be the Betrayer's Titan, the shape-shifting Legendary Titan, Demigorgan. Demigorgan had been transformed into a Holotome and placed in the Professor's room of his castle by Rassimov. [The Spiral Mark] Lok was greatly troubled by this revelation, though he eventually realizes that the image of his father he saw while in the Spirit World was indeed his father. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext: Eathon Lambert is strong willed, determined, and willing go to almost any length to get something done. His loyalty to Simon was clear in how he spent a year at his bedside until his disappearance. {{source|The Secret of Two Generations}} When Lok was little, Eathon was seen as the cool, mysterious dad that always brought home cool treasures, though he was barely seen around the house. {{source|Divide and Conquer}} By all accounts he seems to be a devoted parent and family man. Much like his son, Eathon was highly intuitive, finding unique ways around problems and had a love for puzzles, often building ones of his own for him and Lok to have fun solving. {{source|The Beautiful Trap}}

Eathon was a very talented Seeker who was mentored by the highly-skilled [[Simon Judeau]], from whom he presumably learnt a variety of different spells. Through his adventures, Eathon took possession of several [[Titans]] that he would eventually would leave for his son, [[Lok]] to find through puzzles. He was highly skilled fighter and held his own against [[The Professor's Personal Guard]] for ten years as they chased him across the globe.
